name: Positive Booking Flow - Positive_Standard_Booking_1 -- @1.1
fullName: Hotel Booking Validation Suite: Positive Booking Flow - Positive_Standard_Booking_1

steps.name: Given I navigate to the MakeMyTrip homepage
When I dismiss the login popup and click on the hotels module
And I search for the hotel destination "Hyderabad"
And I trigger the search query
And I apply the 5-star filter on the results page
And I select the first hotel and click Book Now
And I fill guest details from CSV row "1"
And I handle secure trip and continue
Then the system should transition to the payment gateway
